# iciaws — AI Agent Guide

This repo contains a collection of independent Rust crates for building **AWS serverless backends** with Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, SES, SNS, and API Gateway. All crates use Rust 2024 edition and `tokio` for async.

**Git URL**: `https://github.com/intercci/iciaws`
**Add any crate from**: `cargo add iciaws_<name> --git https://github.com/intercci/iciaws --package iciaws_<name>`

---

## Quick Dependency Map

| Crate | Purpose | Key Types |
|-------|---------|-----------|
| `iciaws_router` | HTTP router for Lambda behind API Gateway | `Router`, `AddonHolder`, `RouteHandlerInput`, `RouteHandlerOutput` |
| `iciaws_macros` | `#[route]` and `#[derive(TransDynamo)]` proc macros | — |
| `iciaws_dynamo` | DynamoDB client with composite keys & pagination | `DynamoClient`, `Updates` builder, `QueriesBuilder` |
| `iciaws_s3` | S3 client with presigned URLs | `S3Client` |
| `iciaws_ses` | SES v2 email client | `SesClient` |
| `iciaws_sns` | SNS pub/sub client | `SnsClient` |
| `iciaws_test_helper` | Test utilities (integration tests only) | `create_router`, `call_router`, `create_get`/`create_post` |

---

## iciaws_router — HTTP Router for Lambda

### Setup (main.rs)

```rust
use iciaws_router::{addons::AddonHolder, router::Router};
use lambda_http::{Body, Error, Request, Response, run, service_fn, tracing};
use iciaws_dynamo::get_dynamo_client;
use iciaws_s3::get_s3_client;
use iciaws_ses::get_ses_client;
use iciaws_sns::get_sns_client;
use my_app::routes::add_routes;

async fn function_handler(event: Request, router: &Router) -> Result<Response<Body>, Error> {
    let resp: Response<Body> = router.route(event).await.try_into()?;
    Ok(resp)
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Error> {
    tracing::init_default_subscriber();

    let addons = AddonHolder::new();
    addons.put_addon("dynamo", get_dynamo_client(Some("my-table")).await);
    addons.put_addon("s3", get_s3_client().await);
    addons.put_addon("ses", get_ses_client().await);
    addons.put_addon("sns", get_sns_client().await);

    let mut router = Router::new(addons);
    add_routes(&mut router);

    let router = &router;
    run(service_fn(move |event| async move {
        function_handler(event, router).await
    }))
    .await
}
```

### Adding a Route

1. Create a handler function in `src/handlers/<module>.rs` using `#[route("METHOD/path")]`
2. The `#[route]` macro (from `iciaws_macros`) generates a handler struct named `XxxHandler` with a `get_key()` method
3. Register in `src/routes.rs`:

```rust
use iciaws_router::router::Router;
use crate::handlers::users::{GetUserHandler, QueryUsersHandler};

pub fn add_routes(router: &mut Router) {
    router.add_route(GetUserHandler::get_key(), Box::new(GetUserHandler));
    router.add_route(QueryUsersHandler::get_key(), Box::new(QueryUsersHandler));
}
```

### Handler Signature

```rust
use iciaws_router::{
    addons::AddonHolder,
    input::RouteHandlerInput,
    output::RouteHandlerOutput,
};
use iciaws_macros::route;
use iciaws_dynamo::DynamoClient;
use anyhow::Result;
use http::StatusCode;

#[route("GET/users/{uid}")]
pub async fn get_user(
    input: RouteHandlerInput,
    addons: &AddonHolder,
) -> Result<RouteHandlerOutput> {
    let uid = input.get_path_value("uid")?;
    let dynamo = addons.get::<&DynamoClient>("dynamo")?;
    // ... business logic
    Ok(RouteHandlerOutput::message_output(StatusCode::OK, "found"))
}
```

### RouteHandlerInput API

| Method | Returns | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `input.get_path_value("key")?` | `Result<String>` | Path parameter (required) |
| `input.get_query_value("key")?` | `Result<String>` | Query string parameter (required) |
| `input.get_claim("uid")?` | `Result<String>` | Auth claim from JWT/authorizer (required) |
| `input.get_body_prop_as_str("field")` | `Option<&str>` | Optional body field |
| `input.get_required_body_prop_as_str("field")?` | `Result<&str>` | Required body field as str |
| `input.get_required_body_prop("field")?` | `Result<&Value>` | Required body field as Value |
| `input.body` | `Option<Value>` | Parsed JSON body |
| `input.its_my_path("uid")?` | `Result<String>` | Path param ownership check (matches auth uid) |
| `input.am_i_a("role")` | `bool` | Role check |
| `input.i_am_a("role")?` | `Result<()>` | Role check with error |

### Response Helpers (from `iciaws_router::output`)

```rust
use iciaws_router::output::*;

// Simple message response
RouteHandlerOutput::message_output(StatusCode::OK, "done")

// JSON response
RouteHandlerOutput::json_output(StatusCode::OK, serde_json::json!({ "ok": true }))

// Pre-built helpers
ok_json(json_string)                          // 200 OK
get_ok("user", user_obj)                      // 200 OK, wraps in {status,name,item}
query_ok("users", vec![...])                  // 200 OK, wraps in {status,name,items}
query_page_ok("users", vec![...], last_key)   // 200 OK with pagination
item_created("user", "uid", "abc123")         // 201 Created
item_updated("user")                          // 200 OK
item_deleted("user")                          // 204 No Content
fail_with_message("user", "not found")        // 200 OK with Fail status
ok_with_extra("user", hashmap_of_values)      // 200 OK with extra fields
ok_with_tokens_by_cookie(json, jwt, rtk, domain) // 200 OK with set-cookie headers
preflight(origin)                             // CORS preflight response
```

### Error Helpers (from `iciaws_router::errors`)

```rust
use iciaws_router::errors::*;

bad_request_error("message")     // 400
not_found_error("resource")      // 404
missing_body_field("field")      // 400 — field missing from body
missing_parameter("key", "path") // 400 — parameter missing
missing_token_claim("uid")       // 401 — auth claim missing
unauthorized_error("message")    // 401 — auth failed
```

### AddonHolder — Dependency Injection

```rust
// Store
addons.put_addon("dynamo", dynamo_client);
addons.put_addon("s3", s3_client);

// Retrieve in handler
let dynamo = addons.get::<&DynamoClient>("dynamo")?;
let s3 = addons.get::<&S3Client>("s3")?;
let ses = addons.get::<&SesClient>("ses")?;
let sns = addons.get::<&SnsClient>("sns")?;
```

---

## iciaws_macros — Proc Macros

### `#[route("METHOD/path")]`

Decorates a handler function. Generates:
- A struct `<Name>Handler` implementing `RouteHandler`
- A static `static <NAME>KEY: &'static str = "METHOD/path"`
- A `get_key()` method returning the route string

```rust
use iciaws_macros::route;

#[route("GET/homes/{id}")]
pub async fn get_homes(
    input: RouteHandlerInput,
    addons: &AddonHolder,
) -> Result<RouteHandlerOutput> {
    // handler body
}
// Generates: pub struct GetHomesHandler; impl RouteHandler for GetHomesHandler { ... }
// And: GetHomesHandler::get_key() == "GET/homes/{id}"
```

### `#[derive(TransDynamo)]`

Derives conversion functions between a Rust struct and DynamoDB items. Requires the struct to also implement `DefaultKeys`.

```rust
use iciaws_macros::TransDynamo;
use iciaws_router::types::DefaultKeys;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use anyhow::Result;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, TransDynamo)]
pub struct User {
    pub pk: Option<String>,
    pub sk: Option<String>,
    pub name: String,
}

impl DefaultKeys for User {
    fn set_default_keys(&mut self, from_map: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<()> {
        self.pk = Some(format!("User#{}", from_map.get("uid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown")));
        self.sk = Some("#".to_string());
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

`TransDynamo` generates:
- `pub fn users_from_dynamodb(items: Vec<HashMap<String, AttributeValue>>) -> Result<Vec<User>>` — batch deserialization
- `impl TryFrom<serde_json::Value> for User` — JSON → struct
- `impl TryFrom<HashMap<String, AttributeValue>> for User` — DynamoDB item → struct
- `impl TryFrom<User> for HashMap<String, AttributeValue>` — struct → DynamoDB item

### Crates Required for a TransDynamo Model

A model that uses `#[derive(TransDynamo)]` must import dependencies from three crates:

```toml
[dependencies]
# The macro crate — provides #[derive(TransDynamo)]
iciaws_macros = { git = "https://github.com/intercci/iciaws", package = "iciaws_macros" }
# The router crate — provides DefaultKeys trait and serde support
iciaws_router = { git = "https://github.com/intercci/iciaws", package = "iciaws_router" }
# DynamoDB attribute value type and serde serialization
aws-sdk-dynamodb = "1.116.0"
serde_dynamo = "4.3.0"
anyhow = "1.0.102"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
```

In the source file, the necessary imports are:

```rust
use iciaws_macros::TransDynamo;
use iciaws_router::types::DefaultKeys;
use aws_sdk_dynamodb::types::AttributeValue;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use anyhow::Result;
```

---

## iciaws_dynamo — DynamoDB Client

### Setup

```rust
use iciaws_dynamo::get_dynamo_client;

// Static singleton — initialized once per Lambda invocation
let dynamo = get_dynamo_client(Some("my-table")).await;
// Or without default table (reads TABLE_NAME env var, defaults to "ici-users")
let dynamo = get_dynamo_client(None::<String>).await;
```

### CRUD Operations

```rust
use aws_sdk_dynamodb::types::AttributeValue;
use std::collections::HashMap;
use iciaws_dynamo::DynamoClient;

// PUT (fails if item with same pk/sk exists)
let mut item: HashMap<String, AttributeValue> = HashMap::new();
item.insert("pk".into(), AttributeValue::S("User#alice".into()));
item.insert("sk".into(), AttributeValue::S("#".into()));
dynamo.put(item, None).await?;

// PUT (overwrites existing)
dynamo.put_over(item, None).await?;

// GET by pk/sk strings
let result = dynamo.get_by_pksk("User#alice", "#", None).await?;
let user: User = result.item.unwrap().try_into()?;

// GET by composite key string ("pk~sk")
let result = dynamo.get("User#alice~#", None).await?;

// PUT + deserialize in one step (from JSON value)
use serde_dynamo;
let pitem: HashMap<String, AttributeValue> = serde_dynamo::to_item(my_json_value)?;
dynamo.put_over(pitem, None).await?;
```

### Query Operations

```rust
// Query all items with a given pk (descending by sk)
let results = dynamo.query_by_pk("User#alice", None).await?;

// Query latest N items (sk is timestamp-like, descending)
let results = dynamo.query_latest_by_pk("User#alice", Some(10), None).await?;

// Query by pk with sk prefix match
let results = dynamo.query_by_pk_with_sk_prefix("User#alice", "Post#", None).await?;

// Query with pagination (base64-encoded last_evaluated_key)
let results = dynamo.query_page_by_pk("User#alice", last_key_b64, Some(10), None).await?;

// Query by pk with filter expression (no pagination — small datasets)
let results = dynamo.query_by_pk_with_filter(
    "User#alice",
    "status = :status",
    None,
    Some(HashMap::from([(":status".into(), AttributeValue::S("active".into())]))),
    None,
).await?;
```

### QueriesBuilder — Fluent Query API

```rust
use iciaws_dynamo::queries::QueriesBuilder;
use iciaws_dynamo::pagekey::last_evaluated_key_to_base64;

// Simple pk query with pagination
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .hash_key("User#alice")
    .set_ascending(false)          // default: false (descending)
    .set_page_size(Some(10))
    .set_page_key(last_key)        // None for first page
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// pk + sk prefix
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .hash_key_with_sort_key_prefix("User#alice", "Post#")
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// pk + sk expression (>, <, >=, <=, =)
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .hash_key_with_sort_key_expr("User#alice", ">=", "2024")
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// pk + sk between
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .hash_key_with_sort_key_between("User#alice", "2024-01", "2024-12")
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// With filter
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .hash_key("User#alice")
    .set_filter(
        "contains(#name, :search)",
        Some(HashMap::from([("#name".into(), "name".into())])),
        Some(HashMap::from([(":search".into(), AttributeValue::S("alice".into())]))),
    )
    .set_page_size(Some(10))
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// GSI query
let qo = QueriesBuilder::with_table(&dynamo.client, "my-table")
    .use_index("GSI1Index")
    .key_names("gpk", "gsk")     // custom key names for GSI
    .hash_key("App#main")
    .build()
    .go()
    .await?;

// Extract next page key
let next_key = qo.last_evaluated_key
    .map(|k| last_evaluated_key_to_base64(k).unwrap());
```

### Update Operations

```rust
// Atomic counter increment
dynamo.update_add("User#alice~#", "count", 1, None).await?;

// Update a string field
dynamo.update_s("User#alice~#", "name", "Alice Smith", None).await?;

// Update a numeric field
dynamo.update_n("User#alice~#", "score", 100, None).await?;

// Remove an attribute
dynamo.update_remove_attr("User#alice~#", "temp_field", None).await?;

// Append to a list (creates list if not exists)
let key: HashMap<String, AttributeValue> = HashMap::from([
    ("pk".into(), AttributeValue::S("User#alice".into())),
    ("sk".into(), AttributeValue::S("#".into())),
]);
dynamo.update_add_list_str(key, "tags", "rust").await?;
dynamo.update_add_list(key, "tags", serde_json::json!({"k":"v"})).await?;

// Full update with Updates builder
use iciaws_dynamo::builder::Updates;

let updates = Updates::builder()
    .set_pksk(Some("User#alice"), Some("#"))
    .set("name", &serde_json::json!("Alice"))
    .set("age", &serde_json::json!(30))
    .remove("temp_field")
    .append("tags", &serde_json::json!("new_tag"))
    .add("score", &serde_json::json!(1))
    .build()?;

dynamo.update(updates.key, updates.uex(), updates.ean, updates.eav, None).await?;
```

### Delete Operations

```rust
// Delete by pk/sk strings
dynamo.delete_by_pksk("User#alice", "#", None).await?;

// Delete by composite key string with condition
dynamo.delete("User#alice~#", "attribute_not_exists(deleted)", None).await?;

// Batch delete (auto-chunked to 25)
dynamo.batch_delete(vec![item1, item2, ...], "my-table").await?;

// Delete all items sharing a pk
dynamo.delete_by_pk("User#alice", None).await?;
```

### Composite Keys

Keys use `~` as separator: `"pk~sk"`. The `CompositeKey` type handles parsing and formatting.

```rust
use iciaws_dynamo::ckey::CompositeKey;

// From string
let ck: CompositeKey = "User#alice~Profile".into();
assert_eq!(ck.pk(), "User#alice");
assert_eq!(ck.sk(), "Profile");

// To key hashmap
let hm: HashMap<String, AttributeValue> = ck.into();
// { "pk": S("User#alice"), "sk": S("Profile") }

// Key condition expression (auto-detects prefix queries)
let ck_prefix = CompositeKey::new("User#alice", "Post#*");
assert_eq!(ck_prefix.key_condition_expression(), "pk = :hashKey AND begins_with( sk, :rangeKey )");
```

### Pagination Keys

```rust
use iciaws_dynamo::pagekey::{last_evaluated_key_to_base64, make_start_key};

// Convert DynamoDB key to base64 for URL parameter
let b64 = last_evaluated_key_to_base64(last_evaluated_key)?;

// Convert back for next query
let start_key = make_start_key(Some(b64_string)); // returns Option<HashMap<String, AttributeValue>>
```

## iciaws_s3 — S3 Client

```rust
use iciaws_s3::get_s3_client;

let s3 = get_s3_client().await; // static singleton

// Get object as bytes / string / JSON
let bytes = s3.get_bytes("path/to/file.bin", None).await?;
let text = s3.get_string("config/app.json", None).await?;
let json: serde_json::Value = s3.get_json("config/app.json", None).await?;

// Put object
use aws_sdk_s3::primitives::ByteStream;
let stream = ByteStream::from(bytes);
s3.put_object("uploads/report.pdf", stream, None).await?;

// Presigned URLs
let download_url = s3.get_presign("photos/vacation.jpg", None).await?;  // 60s default
let upload_url = s3.put_presign("photos/vacation.jpg", None).await?;    // 5min default

// List images under a folder (filters .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .webp)
let images = s3.list_images("photos/vacation", None).await?;

// Bucket: reads BUCKET env var, defaults to "ici-uploads"
```

---

## iciaws_ses — SES Email Client

```rust
use iciaws_ses::get_ses_client;

let ses = get_ses_client().await; // static singleton

// Send raw email (full MIME content)
let msg_id = ses.send_raw("from@example.com", vec!["to@example.com"], raw_mime_content).await?;

// Send simple HTML email
let msg_id = ses.send_simple(
    "from@example.com",
    "Subject line",
    vec!["to@example.com"],
    Some(vec!["cc@example.com"]),  // optional CC
    Some(vec!["bcc@example.com"]), // optional BCC
    "<h1>Hello</h1>",
).await?;

// Send template email
let msg_id = ses.send_template(
    "WelcomeTemplate",
    serde_json::to_string(&serde_json::json!({"name": "Alice"})).unwrap(),
    "from@example.com",
    vec!["to@example.com"],
).await?;

// Bulk email with stored template
use iciaws_ses::BulkUserData;
let users = vec![
    BulkUserData { email: "a@example.com".into(), ds: r#"{"name":"Alice"}"#.into() },
    BulkUserData { email: "b@example.com".into(), ds: r#"{"name":"Bob"}"#.into() },
];
ses.send_bulk_template("WelcomeTemplate", r#"{"greeting":"Hi"}"#.into(), users, "from@example.com").await?;

// Bulk email with inline template
ses.send_bulk_inline_template(
    "Subject",
    "<h1>Hello {{name}}</h1>",
    "Hello {{name}}",
    r#"{}"#.into(),
    users,
    "from@example.com",
).await?;

// Template management
ses.list_email_templates().await?;
ses.get_email_template("WelcomeTemplate").await?;
ses.create_template("Name", "Subject", "<html>", "text").await?;
ses.update_template("Name", "Subject", "<html>", "text").await?;
ses.delete_template("Name").await?;

// Contact lists
ses.list_contact_lists().await?;
ses.get_contact_list("ListName").await?;
ses.list_contacts("ListName").await?;
```

---

## iciaws_sns — SNS Client

```rust
use iciaws_sns::get_sns_client;

let sns = get_sns_client().await; // static singleton
// Reads TOPIC_ARN from env var

// Publish to topic (uses TOPIC_ARN env var by default)
let msg_id = sns.publish("Hello world", None).await?;

// Publish to specific topic
let msg_id = sns.publish("Alert!", Some("arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789:my-topic")).await?;
```

## iciaws_test_helper — Integration Testing

Add to `Cargo.toml` as `[dev-dependencies]`:
```toml
iciaws_test_helper = { git = "https://github.com/intercci/iciaws", package = "iciaws_test_helper" }
serial_test = "4.0.1"
```

```rust
use iciaws_test_helper::{call_router, create_get, create_post, create_put, create_delete, create_router, fmt_error, StatusValue};
use my_app::routes::add_routes;

#[tokio::test]
async fn test_get_users() {
    let mut router = create_router("ici-users").await; // uses local DynamoDB
    add_routes(&mut router);

    let req = create_get("/users");
    let StatusValue { status, value } = call_router(&router, req).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(status, http::StatusCode::OK);
    assert_eq!(value["status"].as_str(), Some("OK"));
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn test_create_user() {
    let mut router = create_router("ici-users").await;
    add_routes(&mut router);

    let body = serde_json::json!({"uid": "alice", "name": "Alice", "role": "user"});
    let req = create_post("/users", body);
    let StatusValue { status, value } = call_router(&router, req).await.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(status, http::StatusCode::CREATED);
}

// Custom request with auth claims
use iciaws_test_helper::create_request;
use http::Method;
let req = create_request(Method::GET, "/users/1234", "1234", "admin", None);
// uid=1234, role=admin in authorizer claims
```

---

## Single-Table DynamoDB Design Patterns

### Composite Key Convention
- `pk` = partition key, `sk` = sort key
- Format: `"<Entity>#{id}~<type>#[sub-id>"` e.g. `"User#alice~Profile"`, `"Post#abc123~Comment#xyz"`
- Use `~` as pk/sk separator in ID strings

### Common pk/sk Patterns
```
User#<uid>         ~  #              — User profile
App#<appid>        ~  #              — App config
Post#<id>          ~  #              — Post record
Post#<id>          ~  Comment#<cid>  — Comment on post
```

### Query Patterns
```rust
// Query all posts for a user (descending by sk = newest first)
dynamo.query_page_by_pk("Post#abc123", None, Some(10), None).await?;

// Query with sk prefix (e.g. all comments on a post)
dynamo.query_by_pk_with_sk_prefix("Post#abc123", "Comment#", None).await?;

// Query latest item only
dynamo.query_latest_by_pk("Post#abc123", Some(1), None).await?;
```

---

## Standard Project Structure

```
src/
├── main.rs            — Lambda entrypoint, init clients, register routes
├── routes.rs          — Hand-maintained route registration
├── common/
│   ├── mod.rs
│   └── utils.rs       — Env vars (LazyLock), timestamp helpers, key helpers
├── models/
│   ├── mod.rs         — Re-exports all models
│   └── <entity>.rs    — Model struct with TransDynamo + DefaultKeys + CRUD methods
└── handlers/
    ├── mod.rs         — Re-exports all handler modules
    └── <entities>.rs  — Handler functions with #[route] macro
```

### File Naming Convention

| Purpose | Filename | Example |
|---------|----------|---------|
| Model definition | **singular** | `user.rs` defines `struct User` |
| Handler module | **plural** | `users.rs` contains `GetUserHandler`, `QueryUsersHandler`, etc. |

This convention keeps the model definition and its request handlers clearly separated: one file for the data shape, one file (plural name) for the API surface.

### Adding a Model

1. Create `src/models/<entity>.rs` (singular name) with a `#[derive(TransDynamo)]` struct and a `DefaultKeys` impl:

```rust
use iciaws_macros::TransDynamo;
use iciaws_router::types::DefaultKeys;
use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use anyhow::Result;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, TransDynamo)]
pub struct User {
    pub pk: Option<String>,
    pub sk: Option<String>,
    pub name: String,
    pub email: String,
}

impl DefaultKeys for User {
    fn set_default_keys(&mut self, from_map: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<()> {
        self.pk = Some(format!("User#{}", from_map.get("uid").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("unknown")));
        self.sk = Some("#".to_string());
        Ok(())
    }
}
```

2. Re-export from `src/models/mod.rs`:

```rust
pub mod user;
pub use user::User;
```

### Adding a Request Handler

1. Create `src/handlers/<entities>.rs` (plural name) with `#[route]`-decorated functions:

```rust
use iciaws_macros::route;
use iciaws_router::{
    addons::AddonHolder,
    input::RouteHandlerInput,
    output::RouteHandlerOutput,
};
use anyhow::Result;

#[route("GET/users/{uid}")]
pub async fn get_user(
    input: RouteHandlerInput,
    addons: &AddonHolder,
) -> Result<RouteHandlerOutput> {
    let uid = input.get_path_value("uid")?;
    // ... business logic
    Ok(RouteHandlerOutput::json_output(
        http::StatusCode::OK,
        serde_json::json!({ "uid": uid }),
    ))
}
```

2. Re-export the module from `src/handlers/mod.rs`:

```rust
pub mod users;
```

### Registering the Route

3. Add the generated handler struct to `src/routes.rs`. The `#[route]` macro creates a struct named `<FnName>Handler` (PascalCase of the function name):

```rust
use iciaws_router::router::Router;
use crate::handlers::users::{GetUserHandler, QueryUsersHandler};

pub fn add_routes(router: &mut Router) {
    router.add_route(GetUserHandler::get_key(), Box::new(GetUserHandler));
    router.add_route(QueryUsersHandler::get_key(), Box::new(QueryUsersHandler));
}
```

> **Note:** Always register every handler in `routes.rs`. The `#[route]` macro generates the struct but does **not** register it with the router.

---

## Common Pitfalls

1. **Always register routes** in `src/routes.rs` — the `#[route]` macro generates the handler struct but doesn't register it
2. **Every TransDynamo struct needs DefaultKeys** — required for `try_from(serde_json::Value)` to set pk/sk
3. **Use `Option<String>` with `skip_serializing_if`** for optional model fields to avoid nulls in JSON
4. **Timestamp functions have a typo**: `timextamp_long()` / `timextamp_short()` — preserve for consistency
5. **Static singletons** (`get_dynamo_client`, `get_s3_client`, etc.) are initialized once per Lambda invocation — do not create new clients per request
6. **DynamoDB table name**: defaults to env `TABLE_NAME` or `"ici-users"` — pass `Some("name")` to override
7. **Composite key separator** is `~` (tilde), not `#` — `"pk~sk"` format
8. **Pagination key** is base64url-encoded JSON — use `last_evaluated_key_to_base64()` to serialize, pass `last` query param to resume
9. **Filename convention**: model definition files use the **singular** entity name (e.g. `user.rs`), while the handler module uses the **plural** name (e.g. `users.rs`)
10. **TransDynamo requires importing `iciaws_macros` and `iciaws_router`** — both crates must be in dependencies for the derive macro and `DefaultKeys` trait to be available
